_about: Topic-matched lesson cards (scripts/build-lesson-cta.mjs). Each page points at one lesson from a free unit ('Foundations' or 'Tasting & senses', the first two units of the course), so the browser link never hits the paywall. 'before' is a literal string in the page; the card is inserted just before it. 'band' rewrites the heading and text of the page's dark App Store band.
